verdict.rationale: Belvo documents an Institutions Status page that users can subscribe to for automatic outage notifications, and an API errors reference searchable by error code with causes and solutions. Both come from thin, single-line doc mentions, and nothing shows the error codes separate institution-side failures from integration-side ones. Missing for 10: per-institution status granularity and degradation (not just outage) signals, error-code taxonomy distinguishing bank vs. client faults, API-level institution status fields, independent corroboration.
